history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: How this ministry began
history.paragraph1: Eternal Life Ministry was born in 1995 as a small Bible study group in the home of our founders, Pastor Juan and María Pérez. What started with 10 people became a vibrant community.
history.paragraph2: In 2000, God allowed us to acquire our first land where we built the first temple. Since then, we have grown to include multiple ministries, social aid programs, and missions.
history.paragraph3: Today, our camp welcomes hundreds of people each year seeking a transformative encounter with God. We believe every life matters and together we can make a difference.
history.missionText: To bring the love of Christ to every person, transforming lives through biblical teaching, discipleship, and community service.
history.visionText: To be a faith community that impacts Honduras and the world with the Gospel, forming disciples and serving with love.

projects.title: Transformation Projects
projects.subtitle: Our projects seek to transform lives and communities through Christian love and service

project1.title: Santiago Mission House
project1.description: We support the acquisition of a mission house that serves as a home for our resident missionary in San Pedro Sula, facilitating his evangelistic work and community service.

project2.title: Yolany's Home
project2.description: We regularly support a home that currently provides care and education for children in vulnerable situations, ensuring their basic needs and integral development.

project3.title: GN Children's Home
project3.description: We are working to establish a new home that can shelter and provide a family environment for children in need of a safe place to grow and develop.

project4.title: New Orphanage
project4.description: We seek to expand our reach by opening new homes in different cities of Honduras to serve more children and youth in need.

project5.title: Villanueva Church Project
project5.description: Expansion of our facilities to include spaces dedicated to community programs, childcare, and food services for the community.

project6.title: Gerizem Church Project
project6.description: Planning new facilities that will serve as a worship and community service center, expanding our impact in the region.

project1.name: El Rey Ya Viene - San Pedro Sula
project1.description: We are improving our facilities to offer better spaces for teaching and spiritual development for all ages.

project2.name: El Rey Ya Viene - Quimistán
project2.description: Establishment of a new sister congregation with plans for growth and service to the local community.

project3.name: El Rey Ya Viene - Le Ceba
project3.description: Initiative to bring the Gospel message to a community that currently lacks organized Christian presence.

project4.name: Zacapa Churches
project4.description: Support for multiple sister congregations to improve their spaces and strengthen their local ministry.
